channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: 23-Year-Old Sai Jadhav Becomes First Woman Officer from IMA Dehradun After 93-Year Wait, Joins Family Legacy
item.description: Sai Jadhav, from a four-generation military family, becomes the first woman to pass out from IMA after 93 years, commissioned into the Territorial Army.

item.title: The Burning Thar: Chaos Erupts in Gurugram Village as Miscreants Torch Vehicles, Police Launch Investigation
item.description: Unidentified miscreants allegedly set vehicles ablaze and damaged a house in a Gurugram village, triggering panic, police action, and an ongoing investigation to identify those responsible.

item.title: A Calm and Relaxed Mind Is the Foundation of Creativity and Innovation
item.description: A relaxed mind sharpens perception, improves intuition, and creates the ideal conditions for creativity, innovation, and meaningful problem-solving.

item.title: When Over a Thousand Die and Millions Are Displaced, Southeast Asia’s Floods Become a Warning the World Must Not Ignore
item.description: As unprecedented floods sweep Southeast Asia, millions suffer in silence while global attention lags, exposing dangerous inequalities in climate reporting and the escalating threat facing every nation.

item.title: Bengaluru Techie in ‘Digital Arrest’ Scam Sells Flat, Plots, Loses ₹2 Crore to Shield 10-Year-Old Son
item.description: Bengaluru techie coerced over 5 months to sell home, lands after scammers threaten her son's arrest.

item.title: 52-Year-Old Bengaluru Woman Rides 5,600 km Solo to Conquer 14,200-ft Nathu La Pass Near China Border
item.description: A 52-year-old Bengaluru rider's daring 15-day, 5,600 km solo bike journey to Sikkim's Nathu La Pass inspires millions with her viral video proving age is no barrier.

item.title: Maharashtra Farmer Forced to Sell Kidney After ₹1 Lakh Loan Spirals Into ₹74 Lakh Debt: Reports
item.description: Debt-ridden Maharashtra farmer allegedly sold his kidney in Cambodia after a Rs 1 lakh loan ballooned to Rs 74 lakh.

item.title: Bangladesh Leader Threatens to ‘Cut Off Seven Sisters’ From India; Assam CM Reacts
item.description: Bangladesh NCP leader threatens sheltering anti-India forces; Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma reacts.

item.title: FSSAI Orders Nationwide Crackdown on Adulterated Milk, Paneer and Khoya Amid Festive Season Health Fears
item.description: FSSAI directs states for intensive raids on tainted dairy products enforcing lab tests and heavy penalties.

item.title: Gujarat Anti-Corruption Bureau Arrests CID Crime Inspector, Constable Red-Handed in ₹30 Lakh Bribery Case
item.description: Gujarat ACB arrested two CID officers red-handed for extorting a ₹30 lakh bribe in Gandhinagar.
